title: SignOffs
description: A reviewer's sign-offs on a course's content (ADR 0071): written by the web app's sentence list, applied to the course source by `nabu review apply`. A signed-off sentence or story becomes reviewed, with the reviewer's provenance.

SignOff.title: SignOff
SignOff.description: One item the reviewer read and found right, as it was shown.

item.description: A sentence id, or a story id (a story is signed off whole: its provenance is the story's).

shown.description: sha256 of what the reviewer saw (signoffText in @nabu/core/corrections: every form and translation, as compiled). A sign-off applies only while the source still compiles to it.

at.description: When the reviewer signed it off; its date becomes reviewedAt.
